column1: # Fleet function routing: the one table. fleet-shepherd reads it (line_role, roles_for, pass_prompt, check) and
# tests/unit/fleet_roles.bats pins every row to a real skill and heading. Add a function by adding its row here.
# Columns, tab separated: function, skill, due-line prefixes, section, invoked.
#   prefixes   |-separated; a due line goes to the first row, in file order, with a prefix it starts with (after
#              any "unhandled: "). A bare * is the default row: the lead answers what no other row claims.
#              Empty means no due line routes here; the skill is loaded by name.
#   section    a heading in the skill's SKILL.md (backticks ignored, a prefix of the heading is enough)
#   invoked    "due line" when a pass is handed the skill for a prefix, "by name" otherwise
# Spend and accounts (fleet-accounts and fleet-pace both hold claude-acct) stay split here until the sibling plan
# "account and spend pace owner" moves them; so do worktrees ("worktree lifecycle") and runner roles.
load
delivery
dispatch
lead
accounts
asks
queue
runners
benchmarks
messages
